exercises.title: Past Simple vs Present Perfect — Verifica argomento
exercises.description: Verifica autonoma sulla scelta tra esperienza/risultato collegato al presente e evento collocato in un tempo passato concluso.
exercises.instructions: Leggi l'intero contesto: chiediti se il tempo passato è finito e specificato oppure se conta il risultato/esperienza fino ad ora.

sections.title: Verifica argomento
sections.instructions: Scegli prima il significato temporale, poi costruisci la forma corretta.

questions.title: Item 1
questions.prompt: In 2022 I ___ to Rome with my class.
questions.instructions: Choose the form that fits the finished past time.
questions.learning_objective: Choose Past Simple when the event is located in a finished past time.

feedback.explanation: In 2022 is a finished past time: went.

questions.title: Item 2
questions.prompt: I can't pay for the ticket. I ___ my wallet.
questions.instructions: Choose the form that explains the problem now.
questions.learning_objective: Choose Present Perfect for a past event whose result matters now.

feedback.explanation: The missing wallet is a current result: have lost.

questions.title: Item 3
questions.instructions: Notice how the conversation moves from current status to a specific past detail.
questions.learning_objective: Switch from Present Perfect status to Past Simple detail in one exchange.

content.text_template: A: [[blank_1]] you finished the project? B: Yes. I [[blank_2]] the final section last night.

feedback.explanation: Current completion status: Have you finished? Specific last night detail: wrote.

questions.title: Item 4
questions.prompt: Correct: I have seen Marco yesterday after school.
questions.learning_objective: Correct Present Perfect used with a finished past-time expression.

accepted_answers: I saw Marco yesterday after school.

questions.title: Item 5
questions.instructions: Use the tense required by each part of the context.
questions.learning_objective: Move from general life experience to details of a specific completed trip.

content.text_template: I [[blank_1]] (visit) London three times. The last time I [[blank_2]] (go) there was in April. We [[blank_3]] (stay) near King's Cross and [[blank_4]] (see) two shows.

feedback.explanation: General experience: have visited. Specific trip in April: went, stayed, saw.

questions.title: Item 6
questions.prompt: Select all sentences whose tense fits the context.
questions.instructions: There may be more than one correct answer.
questions.learning_objective: Evaluate tense choice and grammatical form across current and finished-past contexts.

options.text: I've lost my phone, so I can't call her.
She has finished the exercise yesterday.

feedback.explanation: Check whether a finished past time is stated and whether the Present Perfect participle is correct.

questions.title: Item 7
questions.prompt: Choose the most natural follow-up question.
questions.instructions: Read how the conversation moves from experience to a specific event.
questions.learning_objective: Use Past Simple to ask for a specific detail after a Present Perfect experience statement.

options.text: When did you go the last time?
When have you gone the last time?
When did you went the last time?

feedback.explanation: A specific last trip needs did + base form.

questions.title: Item 8
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.instructions: Ask for the specific time of a completed event.
questions.learning_objective: Build a Past Simple question asking when a completed event happened.

feedback.explanation: When did you buy this laptop?

questions.title: Item 9
questions.prompt: Sono stato a Parigi tre volte. L'ultima volta ci sono andato nel 2024 e ho soggiornato vicino al Louvre.
questions.learning_objective: Produce Present Perfect experience followed by Past Simple details.

accepted_answers: I've been to Paris three times. The last time I went there was in 2024 and I stayed near the Louvre.
I have been to Paris three times. The last time I went there was in 2024 and I stayed near the Louvre.

feedback.explanation: Have been for experience; went/stayed for the specific 2024 trip.

questions.title: Item 10
questions.prompt: Ho perso il telefono e non posso chiamarti. Credo di averlo lasciato sul treno: ieri sera sono tornato alla stazione, ma non l'ho trovato.
questions.instructions: Translate the full context into English.
questions.learning_objective: Combine a current Present Perfect result with specific Past Simple follow-up details.

accepted_answers: I've lost my phone and I can't call you. I think I've left it on the train: last night I went back to the station, but I didn't find it.
I have lost my phone and I cannot call you. I think I have left it on the train: yesterday evening I went back to the station, but I did not find it.

feedback.explanation: Present result: have lost/have left. Finished last-night detail: went/didn't find.
